claire: tiny follow-up: what about tagging samples with model-family invariants like tokenizer_version and vocab-hash so we avoid false-positives when tokenizer changes?

omar: yes, add tokenizer_version and preprocess_hash to provenance. if tokenizer changed, treat as separate admission path.

ren: also: pin a small 'canary canonicalizer' for text normalization to reduce spurious diffs (strip punctuation, normalize whitespace) prior to fuzzy compare.
